discovery_notes: 29 searches, snippets only. Leads not followed: Star Wars Galaxy's Edge 2020 monthly LE 1500 ($17.99) names not found; 2021 Dream Destinations May (Cheshire Cat, Tulgey Wood) and June (Hercules, Mount Olympus) seen in an unattributed snippet; Pua/Motunui seen only at a reseller. One Family 2022 jumbo set (LE 300, $175) and merry-go-round jumbo (LE 500, $150) reported at Disneyland in Sept 2022 but are EPCOT event leftovers, excluded. No 2021 reopening-day-specific LE found; Magic is Back is the closest. No D23/Disney100 DLR LE for 2022 surfaced. Christmas Resorts 2021 availability date given for WDW only (2021-11-02). Hatbox Ghost LE 3000 Disneyland Parade pin is 2024, out of scope.
